description: Free, no API key. Find where one app ranks today for one keyword in one storefront, from a live store search. The App Store search is read about 200 results deep and Google Play about 30; an app below that depth has no rank in the answer, which does not mean it is unranked.

country.description: Two-letter storefront code (e.g. us, gb, de). Defaults to us.

platform.description: Store to read. Defaults to ios.

store_id.description: App Store numeric id or Google Play package name (from find_app).

name: check_keyword_rank
